strings: Good morning Darren.  So sorry I missed your call yesterday. What time would be convenient to call?
s regarding a settlement agreement with JLR
Hi Darren, were you able to get any legal advice for me?  The 3 month date is tomorrow.

Tim, Good afternoon,  The ACAS information is not imperative at this very moment whilst the ACAS early conciliation is ongoing, I wanted it for information purposes. It is the outcome from ACAS that is important. I will need this information eventually dependant on the ACAS outcome obviously.  You can only do what you can, when you can, and I will also assist and advise where I am able to.
Hi Darren, were you able to get any legal advice for me?
Good morning. I am currently in a meeting and will call following the meeting later today. In advance can you explain who this is as it
s a random number.  Thank you  Regards Darren
s Tim Loftus, regarding my IHER and the OHP's conduct
Good morning Tim. I will call following my meeting, it should be around 1230.  Regards  Darren
ve not been able to forward the ACAS stuff, PC is down and can
t see this phone without using a magnifying glass. This is obviously holding up the appeal
Hi Darren, hope all is good?  I
ve not received the form you said your office was going to send me mate, do you know if it
s been sent? Just concerned about the timescale deadline
m sure it would of, but I will check. Can you text me your address so I can also make sure that was correct.  Thank you for letting me know
s: 9 Fir Grove, Tile Hill, Coventry, CV4 9FU
ve got the office to send it recorded delivery this time. It

s missed the post today so it will go Tuesday. Ive asked them to send me an electronic version (if that helps)so I can email it to you as well. The difference between email and post. You get a return envelope to send it back, but as long as you can print it off you could continue and complete it, and return it in the envelope when the post arrives.  I hope that makes sense.
ll sort it over the weekend.  Pinning my hope on this, they didn
t tell me that I had the opportunity to change the pension to a DC, meaning there would have been another 8 year to the pot, but can only do it while still being employed by them

This is why it is important to raise this sort of issue with the pension ombudsman and the failing in the management of the scheme etc. alongside side this there is the dismissal to deal with which does fall within the tribunal
s jurisdiction.  I have just sent those forms electronically.  Have a good weekend Regards Darren
t received the letter you were going to have sent to me by registered post, please can you check it has been sent as the calendar month for ACAS is tomorrow
Tim, good morning. I am just in a meeting. I have sent you an email earlier this morning regarding your earlier text. Let me know if you have not received my email.  Many thanks  Regards Darren
Hi Darren, Sorry I missed your call yesterday, after sending the appeal off I switched the phone to silent and got me head down for a bit. Today
Hi Darren, Please can you have the union appoint a solicitor to take instruction on this matter.

Tim, Good afternoon. The solicitors/legal adviser require the ET3 as per my previous/last email. This will allow/help them to give a decision as to whether unite will support your claim or not.  Regards Darren Hall

I need you to start taking this matter seriously!  Having being diagnosed with cancer, I am protected by disability discrimination and, by JLR not following their own processes, not to mention the minimum code of conduct published by ACAS, I have what
s referred to as Automatic Disability Discrimination.  You have held off on providing me the help I need and expect from an organisation I
ve been a member of for many years, just in case I needed union support.  If you
re not going to help me, please put me in contact with someone, through unite, who can!

Tim please, you do not have to apologise. I can only imagine what your going through. So please do not feel you have to apologise. But I am glad to hear your daughter is home at least, and hopefully continues on the road to recovery.

Thank you so much Darren, me too.  And, regarding the email I sent, I hope it didn't come across negatively? With everything going on I wasn't able to sleep, with the JLR matter playing on my mind and feeling everything slipping away from me.
No mate I didn't take it in that way at all.
https://www.pensionsage.com/pa/TPO-launches-Pensions-dishonesty-unit.php  TPO launches Pensions Dishonesty Unit - Pensions Age Magazine.  Sorry for texting you while you
re away from work but, thought you
Thank you for stitching me up

t think you understand the situation, Roy Brown works for JLR, he is also the Secretary for the Trustees and the designated decision maker, he is able to delay the process to the point where the employees employment is terminated and then treats the schemes members are treated as deferred members. This is not just me, it
s how JLR handles all employee applications to the pension scheme.  How can one person be responsible for 2 independent processes?
Hi Darren, it has come to my attention that JLR are not compliant with the legal requirements of the HSE. Company employed GP

s need to be registered on the HSE list of approved doctors: https://www.hse.gov.uk/doctors/employers.htm.  None of JLR doctors are or have ever been on this list!  If I make this public or go to the HSE, I
m worried it could cause all UK JLR facilities to be shut down.  Please could I have Union support?
Good morning. Firstly your on a retired membership. A retired membership does not give you legal advice or support on employment issues. Why not? Because obviously you are not employed if you

re retired, and a retired member would not require legal support on employment matters. This is also a new matter/issue you wish to raise.  Secondly, regardless of your membership, this is not an employment matter and would not be dealt with through any employment arena. I see this as a civil matter and would be dealt with through those procedures. So matters of this nature would also not be dealt with for someone with a full membership and in employment.  You do have initial free legal advice as part of your membership, for none employment matters. I

m not sure if this is something you could take some initial advice. The freephone number is on the unite website. It is only free initial advice and then you would pay if you required further support.  I hope this helps  Regards Darren
Actually, this is very much about a current employment issue, as well you know. My MWET case has a stay of processings and is due to be heard on 10th November 2023. This is new evidence that JLR
s capability process was not compliant with their legal requirements under the HSE. My capability review ended when JLR

s process was compliant when they received a report from a doctor who was legally able to provide such reports and that was when they received the report from Dr. Sheard from Health Partners, who is on this list and is the report which triggers JLR
s liability to enhance my pension.  Please, you know this is going on, why is Unite letting their members down?  I would have thought the Union would have been a little more interested in JLR
s indisputable breach of HSE legal requirements.  After all it does directly impact every employee at every JLR facility in the UK!!!  I don

t feel reassured your response addressed the subject matter but, if you are not interested in the safety of our brother union members, especially those who are performing maintenance work during shutdown, where JLR are not providing them with what everyone believes they are, it is fact, please at least look out for our fellow brothers or, is your response have something more personal to do with me?

Good morning, Your claim is largely in the hands of the pension ombudsman and any et claim is stayed until further info from that.  I personally do not see This information will have any bearing on your claim for unfair dismissal for the reasons you have already been given.  It may have a bearing on the claim with the pension ombudsman, but as previous stated, this is an area/claim we do not cover.  I am on annual leave until the 5th September. on my return I will make our legal solicitors aware of this new information, and will ask their advise if this info has any bearing on your et claim for unfair dismissal, and I will formally respond back to you.  Regards  Darren
Sorry I forgot to also add.  I will also look into claims for the sake of others on my return.

Good morning. It was late on yesterday that I picked up my messages. I am in meetings this morning but I can call This afternoon. Is there a better time for yourself later on?
